ServiceCanadaCentre.heading: Get ready to visit a Service Canada Centre
ServiceCanadaCentre.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
ServiceCanadaCentre.step1: Continue to receive your unique identification code for in-person proofing, valid for 30 days
ServiceCanadaCentre.step2: Find the closest available Service Canada Centre to visit in-person with your code and one valid identity document
ServiceCanadaCentre.step3: Once the Service Canada agent confirms proofing is complete, you can sign back into the service
ServiceCanadaCentre.receiveCodeDescription: The next screen will generate your unique identification code that you will use for your in-person proofing at Service Canada.
ServiceCanadaCentre.emailInstructions: Instructions along with your code will also be emailed to your following address:
ServiceCanadaCentre.learnMoreLink: Learn more about Service Canada Centre identity proofing

ServiceCanadaCentreCode.heading: Here is your unique identification code for your identity proofing
ServiceCanadaCentreCode.codeValidDays: This code is valid for 30 days and has been emailed to
ServiceCanadaCentreCode.visitInstruction: Visit a Service Canada Centre with your code and one valid ID document.
ServiceCanadaCentreCode.findNearestTitle: Find your nearest Service Canada Centre
ServiceCanadaCentreCode.findNearestBody: Complete your identity proofing at an available

ProvincialVerification.heading: Get ready for provincial partner sign in
ProvincialVerification.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
ProvincialVerification.step1: Have your provincial partner app ready
ProvincialVerification.step2: Select the appropriate option and follow the steps to prove your identity
ProvincialVerification.step3: Once the proofing is complete, you will be automatically redirected
ProvincialVerification.learnMoreLink: Learn more about provincial identity proofing

OnlineVerificationInfo.heading: Get ready for selfie and ID check
OnlineVerificationInfo.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
OnlineVerificationInfo.step1: You will need one government issued photo ID
OnlineVerificationInfo.step2: Take a selfie and a photo of your ID in a well lit room using a mobile phone camera with a high resolution
OnlineVerificationInfo.step3: Confirm your submission and get your proofing results to continue
OnlineVerificationInfo.planForTime: Plan for about 5 minutes to complete this process.
OnlineVerificationInfo.learnMoreLink: Learn more about how selfie and ID check works
